name: Anthropic Web Search

env_keys.comment: Comparison only; anysearch does not read a key for this provider.

mode.comment: Tool versions 20250305, 20260209 and 20260318 provide basic search, dynamic filtering and response-inclusion controls; model availability varies.

notes: Comparison only; no anysearch SDK adapter is claimed.

requires_key.comment: Claude API authentication is required; web_search is a server tool in an authenticated Messages request.

snippet.comment: Search result blocks expose encrypted_content rather than plaintext snippets; citations may return cited_text up to 150 characters.

domains.comment: allowed_domains or blocked_domains restrict searches; mutually exclusive in one tool configuration.

country.comment: user_location.country is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; approximate localization supported.

language.comment: No result-language filter is documented in the reviewed web_search parameter guide. Multilingual model output is not retrieval-language enforcement.

date.comment: page_age is response metadata; the reviewed request controls do not establish an enforced publication-date-range filter.

safe_search.comment: No configurable SafeSearch switch is documented in the reviewed server-tool guide. Safety policy and retrieval filter are distinct.

answer.comment: Claude returns a final answer with citations after tool searches.

content.comment: Search content is encrypted for continuation; plaintext page/document fetching is a separate web_fetch tool, not included raw search output.

summary.comment: Cited answer generation is not a per-result page-summary API; search result blocks have URL/title/page_age/encrypted_content.

highlights.comment: Citation cited_text contains up to 150 characters of cited source content; limited citation excerpts, not arbitrary full-page highlighting.

news.comment: Official documentation lists recent news as a web-search use case; no news-only vertical control is documented.

native_api.value: Claude server-side web search tool; not standalone raw search. Generated answers and search-result processing add model costs.

rate_limits.value: Model/tool limits vary; tool use requires compatible model

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.

pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.
